candidates.description: This vector represents subatomic particles, atomic nuclei, and fundamental physical matter or energy components.
These tokens represent Greek letters and mathematical symbols commonly used in scientific and technical notation.
This vector represents words related to containment, contamination, and transport.
This feature vector represents foundational or constituent parts and items across multiple languages.
This vector represents multilingual adjectival suffixes related to capability, possibility, or capacity (such as "-able", "-ible", and "-ível").
This vector activates for modal and auxiliary verbs indicating possibility, necessity, or capability across multiple European languages.
This vector represents the concept of utilization, usefulness, and the action of using across multiple languages.
This vector represents units of measurement and quantification, particularly involving percentages, weight, and large numbers.
This vector represents additive, restrictive, and temporal adverbial modifiers expressing concepts like "already," "still," "also," and "only" across multiple languages.
This vector activates for demonstrative determiners like "this," "these," and their translations in other languages.
